title: Main wind-force-resisting system.
officialText:
Main wind force-resisting systems shall comply with the following:
1. The building shall be designed for the following net lateral wind pressure to be applied to the horizontal projection of the building surfaces: 1.1. From 0 to 100 feet (0 to 30 480 mm) elevation 20 psf (0.96 kN/m2). 1.2. From 100 to 300 feet (30 480 to 91 440 mm) elevation 25 psf (1.2 kN/m2).
2. An importance factor, I, shall be determined in accordance with Section 1609.5 and shall be applied to the pressures indicated above.
